acceptanceCriteria: Every code citation into cmd/corvint/local_completion_event.go in decision 0161 and falsifiable-packet-v0.md is an identifier reference (decision prose otherwise unchanged).
make line-citations-check passes before and after a scratch one-line insertion at the top of cmd/corvint/local_completion_event.go (reverted).
body: Residual from the V1-1395/1396/1342 docs lane (PR #917, head bae2bd240, base 6a152b2ba). A scratch one-line insertion at the top of cmd/corvint/local_completion_event.go fails script/check-line-citations.sh only on pinned citations outside local-completion-policy-v0.md: docs/decisions/0161-*.md (':356@b0ea6e77') and docs/specs/falsifiable-packet-v0.md lines 118 and 834 (':408-417@3ebad936'). Expected: identifier references (file plus enclosing function) as V1-1350/V1-1395 did for the LCP spec. Actual: pinned path:line citations that any edit above them breaks. Also noted: TestIndexImplementationPathsExist (V1-1342) and its neighbour check the worktree filesystem, not the git index.
title: Pinned line citations into cmd/corvint/local_completion_event.go (decision 0161, falsifiable-packet-v0.md) break on any insertion above them
